# Groundledger

> MIT agent skills for Claude Code, Cursor, and Cowork: CLEAR blog publishing, SPARK editorial, SNAP/PULSE social, ORBIT discovery, PROBE site SEO, SAFE paid media (observe-only by default). No fabricated statistics.

- Code: https://github.com/dranshrad/groundledger
- Docs: https://dranshrad.github.io/groundledger/
- Brand card: https://dranshrad.github.io/groundledger/brand.md
- Grounding Law: https://github.com/dranshrad/groundledger/blob/master/skills/blog-engine/references/grounding.md

Formerly Clearcast; renamed to Groundledger. Not affiliated with Clearcast UK or other ClearCast apps.
